title: Rennet made by microbes
subtitle: The calf gene, in a bacterium
subtitle_es: El gen del ternero, en una bacteria
objective: Assemble the genetic circuit that lets a bacterium make chymosin, the enzyme that curdles milk.
objective_es: Monta el circuito genético que permite a una bacteria fabricar quimosina, la enzima que cuaja la leche.
description: Cheese needs chymosin. Instead of taking it from calves, the gene of the calf can be placed in a microbe that makes it in a tank.
description_es: El queso necesita quimosina. En lugar de sacarla de los terneros, el gen del ternero se puede poner en un microbio que la fabrique en un tanque.

organism.commonName: A bacterium with a calf gene
organism.commonName_es: Una bacteria con un gen de ternero
organism.description: A laboratory bacterium that makes the enzyme of the calf.
organism.description_es: Una bacteria de laboratorio que fabrica la enzima del ternero.

exploration.label: The enzyme
exploration.title: Chymosin curdles milk
exploration.description: Chymosin snips one protein of milk and makes it set. Calves make it in their stomach to digest their mother's milk.
exploration.description_es: La quimosina corta una proteína de la leche y hace que cuaje. Los terneros la fabrican en el estómago para digerir la leche de su madre.

exploration.label: The circuit
exploration.title: Read, make, stop
exploration.description: The bacterium needs a promoter to start reading, a landing strip for the ribosome, the gene itself and a terminator that says where to stop.
exploration.description_es: La bacteria necesita un promotor para empezar a leer, una pista de aterrizaje para el ribosoma, el gen mismo y un terminador que diga dónde parar.

parts.label: Inducible promoter
parts.description: Switches on when the inducer is added.
parts.description_es: Se enciende cuando se añade el inductor.

parts.label: Switched-off promoter
parts.description: A promoter that is never switched on in this culture.
parts.description_es: Un promotor que nunca se enciende en este cultivo.
parts.wrongReason: This promoter is never switched on here, so the gene would never be read.
parts.wrongReason_es: Este promotor nunca se enciende aquí, así que el gen no se leería nunca.

parts.label: RBS
parts.description_es: Pista de aterrizaje para el ribosoma.

parts.label: Prochymosin gene
parts.description: Recipe for the inactive form of chymosin, which becomes active in acid.
parts.description_es: Receta de la forma inactiva de la quimosina, que se activa con ácido.

parts.label: lacZ gene
parts.description: Recipe for an enzyme that turns blue when it works.
parts.description_es: Receta de una enzima que se vuelve azul cuando funciona.
parts.wrongReason: lacZ makes a blue colour, not the enzyme that curdles milk.
parts.wrongReason_es: lacZ fabrica un color azul, no la enzima que cuaja la leche.

steps.label: Rennet
steps.description_es: Listo para la cuba del queso.

hints.title: Big picture
hints.content: You need a promoter that works, a landing strip, the gene that makes the enzyme and a terminator.
hints.content_es: Hacen falta un promotor que funcione, una pista de aterrizaje, el gen que fabrica la enzima y un terminador.

hints.title: Next step
hints.content: Leave out the promoter that is always off and the gene for a blue colour: they do not belong to this circuit.
hints.content_es: Deja fuera el promotor que está siempre apagado y el gen de un color azul: no pertenecen a este circuito.

completion.title: A calf gene in a bacterium
completion.title_es: Un gen de ternero en una bacteria
completion.summary: You assembled the circuit that lets a microbe make an enzyme from a calf, and saw why the circuit needs each of its four pieces.
completion.summary_es: Has montado el circuito que permite a un microbio fabricar una enzima de un ternero, y has visto por qué el circuito necesita cada una de sus cuatro piezas.
completion.realWorldImpact: Most of the rennet used in cheese today is made by microbes in tanks, which gives a steady supply that does not depend on the number of calves.
completion.realWorldImpact_es: La mayor parte del cuajo que se usa hoy en el queso lo fabrican microbios en tanques, lo que da un suministro estable que no depende del número de terneros.

science.realWorldCase: In 1983 a team in the United Kingdom reported that the calf gene for prochymosin, placed in Escherichia coli, produced the protein. In 1990 chymosin made by microbes was approved for food in the United States.
science.realWorldCase_es: En 1983 un equipo del Reino Unido describió que el gen de la proquimosina del ternero, puesto en Escherichia coli, producía la proteína. En 1990 se aprobó en Estados Unidos la quimosina fabricada por microbios para alimentos.
science.scientificContext: Prochymosin is an inactive form that cuts itself and becomes chymosin in acid. In E. coli the protein tends to pile up in clumps that have to be dissolved and refolded, which is why industry later moved to fungi and yeasts.
science.scientificContext_es: La proquimosina es una forma inactiva que se corta a sí misma y se convierte en quimosina con ácido. En E. coli la proteína tiende a acumularse en grumos que hay que disolver y plegar de nuevo, por eso la industria se pasó después a hongos y levaduras.
gameplaySimplifications: Real constructs have more pieces, such as a selection marker; here only the main parts are used.
gameplaySimplifications_es: Los montajes reales tienen más piezas, como un marcador de selección; aquí solo se usan las partes principales.

references.title: Synthesis of calf prochymosin (prorennin) in Escherichia coli
